items.title: Cash Prices Fizzle as Eastern Natural Gas Hubs Retreat
items.summary: Spot prices for natural gas delivered over the weekend and Monday varied by region but gave up ground overall as signs of milder weather in the northern Midwest and East pushed buyers to the sidelines.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Find Way Forward as Punishing Heat Melts Texas, West
items.summary: Natural gas futures bounced back on Friday as intense heat across a majority of the country outshined the weight of plump supply that had bogged down the market the previous session.

items.title: Solitude FID Sparks Jump in Long-Dated Waha Natural Gas Forward Curve

items.title: Global Natural Gas Prices Rally to Highest Level in Years
items.summary: European and Asian natural gas prices continued their rally on Friday, settling at the highest levels since January 2023 as threats to global supplies continue to grow.

items.title: Weather Models Ratchet Up CDDs, Boosting Natural Gas Ahead of Weekend
items.summary: Sharply hotter forecast runs helped September natural gas futures edge higher through midday Friday, teasing the prospect of a second straight week of modest gains for the prompt month.

items.title: Near-Record ERCOT Load Tests Texas Natural Gas Demand
items.summary: Near-record Texas electricity demand is producing a sharp evening ramp in natural gas-fired generation, but East Texas physical gas prices weakened even as the grid approached its all-time load record.

items.title: US LNG Export Capacity Poised to Enter Next Wave of Growth
items.summary: Another wave of US LNG export projects is close to coming online as the last continues ramping up, with new facilities on track to add nearly 8 Bcf/d between 2027 and the first half of 2028.

items.title: Mexico Imports of US Natural Gas Surge on Summer Heat
items.summary: US natural gas is pouring across the southern border this August at levels above 8 Bcf/d as hot weather bolsters cooling demand in Mexico and attractive pricing predominates.
